passage.label: Established way Allah occurred before never find way Allah any change; withheld their hands from you your hands from them within Makkah after caused overcome them ever Allah what do Seeing; ones disbelieved obstructed Masjid al-Haram offering prevented reaching place sacrifice; if not for believing men women did not know trample befall dishonor without knowledge permitted enter Makkah so Allah might admit mercy whom willed; if apart would have punished disbelieved among them painful punishment; disbelieved put hearts chauvinism chauvinism time ignorance; Allah sent down tranquillity Messenger believers imposed word righteousness more deserving worthy ever Allah all things Knowing; certainly Allah showed Messenger vision truth; surely enter Masjid al-Haram if Allah wills safety heads shaved hair shortened not fearing; knew what did not know arranged before conquest near hand; sent Messenger guidance religion truth manifest over all religion sufficient Allah Witness; Muhammad Messenger Allah those with him forceful against disbelievers merciful among themselves; see bowing prostrating seeking bounty Allah pleasure; mark faces trace prostration; description Torah; description Gospel plant produces offshoots strengthens grow firm stand upon stalks delighting sowers so Allah enrage by them disbelievers; Allah promised believe righteous deeds among them forgiveness great reward

arabicExcerpts.text: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلٗا
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَّ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ عَنكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيَكُمۡ عَنۡهُم بِبَطۡنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَنۡ أَظۡفَرَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَٱلۡهَدۡيَ مَعۡكُوفًا أَن يَبۡلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥۚ وَلَوۡلَا رِجَالٞ مُّؤۡمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٞ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتٞ لَّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوهُمۡ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمۡ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنۡهُم مَّعَرَّةُۢ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۖ لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ لَوۡ تَزَيَّلُواْ لَعَذَّبۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

إِذۡ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَأَلۡزَمَهُمۡ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهۡلَهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٗا

لَّقَدۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءۡيَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ لَتَدۡخُلُنَّ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمۡ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُواْ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتۡحٗا قَرِيبًا
هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلۡحَقِّ لِيُظۡهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدٗا

مُّحَمَّدٞ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ تَرَىٰهُمۡ رُكَّعٗا سُجَّدٗا يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنٗاۖ سِيمَاهُمۡ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِۚ وَمَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡإِنجِيلِ كَزَرۡعٍ أَخۡرَجَ شَطۡـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسۡتَغۡلَظَ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعۡجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ مِنۡهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٗ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمَۢا

mainSubject.label: The established way of Allah confirmed as unchanging; His withholding of both sides' hands within Makkah after granting overcoming, seeing all actions; obstruction of al-Masjid al-Haram and prevention of the sacrificial offering cited, with entry restrained only to protect unknown believers from trampling-dishonour and to admit mercy to whom He wills, otherwise painful punishment would have struck the disbelievers; jahiliyya chauvinism placed in disbelievers' hearts against tranquillity and the word of righteousness imposed on the Messenger and believers who were most deserving; the vision shown to the Prophet in truth confirmed — safe entry to al-Masjid al-Haram with shaved or shortened heads and no fear, with an earlier near conquest arranged beyond their knowledge; the Messenger sent with guidance and the religion of truth to prevail over all religions, Allah sufficing as Witness; Muhammad named Messenger of Allah, his companions forceful against disbelievers yet merciful among themselves, seen bowing and prostrating seeking bounty and pleasure, their facial marks from prostration described in the Torah and compared in the Gospel to a strengthening plant delighting sowers so that Allah enrages the disbelievers through them; forgiveness and great reward promised to those among them who believe and do righteous deeds

notes: Wave 7 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the pledge-allegiance-to-Allah sequence (10) before the bedouin-excuses block opens (11); P2 ends with the imminent-conquest-and-booty promise (19) plus the competence affirmation (20-22 contextually linked); P3 runs from the unchanging sunnah through the Masjid al-Haram restraint, the vision confirmation, the Messenger's universal mission and the closing companion-description with reward (23-29). Note: P2 includes verses 20-22 as part of the booty-and-competence continuation despite the thematic shift, keeping the passage count at 3 for this 29-verse surah.
